[[Shekoss the Stony]] is an [[Awakened]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Joko's Domain]].

== Locations ==
* [[The Desolation]]
** {{NPC location|Joko's Domain}} (not during [[A Deal's a Deal]]) 

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aftershock}}
* {{skill icon|Ebon Hawk}}
* {{skill icon|Enervating Charge}}
* {{skill icon|Gale}}
* {{skill icon|Glowstone}}
* {{skill icon|Obsidian Flesh}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Shekoss' Staff]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* It is possible to kill this boss to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] its [[elite skill|elite]] without completing the [[Gate of Desolation]] [[mission]]. Joko's Domain is accessible via [[Basalt Grotto]] and the path to this boss does not go through any [[Sulfurous Haze]] sand.
* There are many creatures surrounding Shekoss the Stony, so [[pull]]ing is essential if you want to kill him.
